{{Quote|A skilled shadow killer can vanish from sight.|[[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]|<ref name="BoSSotDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Shadow killer''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] rank and specialization. It was one of three categories of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] skill offered to offworld clients by the Nightsister clan, the other two being those of '''''[[Hunter (Nightsister)/Legends|hunter]]''''' and '''''[[Warrior (Nightsister)|warrior]]'''.'' All [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] mercenaries, which included those from the ranks of both the Nightsisters and the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]], were chosen from the successful endurance of the trials of [[Selection/Legends|Selection]].<ref name="BoSSotDS" />

==Overview==
A shadow killer was an assassin from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. They carried weapons that were silent and easy to conceal, such as [[Nightsister dagger|daggers]] and darts dipped in poison. They also wore [[Color/Legends|black]] wraps to help them blend in with the dark. [[Shaman of the Nightsisters|Shamans of the Nightsisters]] such as [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] could summon a mist (a cloak of [[Spirit ichor/Legends|spirit ichor]]) that allowed these killers to walk midway between the physical realm and the [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|spirit realm]].<ref name="BoSSotDS" />

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Mother (title)/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] allowed [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to use the Shadow Killers' mist (ichor cloak) to avenge herself of her former master, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], with the aid of two of the coven's finest warriors, [[Karis/Legends|Karis]] and [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]]. Talzin also provided Ventress with the poisoned dart of the assassins.<ref name="TCWNS">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>

According to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the stealth skills of the shadow killers could easily rival those of the [[Defel/Legends|Defels]] agents. This is why the Emperor ordered the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] to conscript from the Nightsister assassins some time after [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="BoSSotDS" />
